title: BLFSentenceFamily
description: A conceptual sentence family grouping realizations sharing an identical semantic proposition.

proposition_description.description: English description of core underlying semantic proposition.

semantic_frame_id.description: ID of underlying semantic frame (e.g., FRAME-COMMERCE-BUY).

canonical_utterance_id.description: ID of the canonical Bangladesh Standard Bangla (BDSB) realization.

realization_utterance_ids.description: List of all realization utterance IDs belonging to this family.
